label: ✳ 선태류 삭치 × 포자 융선 — 30·40대
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot.
Two women standing shoulder to shoulder, arms lightly touching, NO GAP between them, matched height. LEFT: late thirties. RIGHT: mid forties.
Both hourglass figures, narrow waists and broad rounded hips.
LEFT hair: dark brown in two low braids. RIGHT hair: black, long and loose over one shoulder.

POSE — ASYMMETRIC PAIR, NOT mirror images:
LEFT stands with her back mostly to the camera at 45 degrees, weight on one leg, hip pushed out, head turned back over the shoulder toward the lens.
RIGHT faces the camera squarely in mid-turn, one foot crossing behind the other, torso rotating so one shoulder leads, one arm raised to the collarbone.
CONTACT: LEFT's inner hand rests on RIGHT's forearm.

Body fully painted with: false-color bryophyte micrograph texture, no unpainted ground anywhere.
LEFT — moss peristome teeth: rings of slender tapered teeth radiating outward from repeated circular centers, each tooth cross-barred with fine horizontal ridges and hinged at its base, the rings tiled densely across the body, in false-color burnt sienna, ochre and pale bone.
RIGHT — fern spore ornamentation: hundreds of rounded trilete spores, each marked with a Y-shaped scar and wrapped in low winding surface ridges, packed tightly with fine granular texture filling the gaps, in the SAME burnt sienna, ochre and pale bone palette at the same small scale. Ridges only, no spines, no projections.

Both share one color temperature and ground tone so the pair reads as a single specimen plate. No transition or blending between the figures is needed.

SURFACE — MANDATORY: bone-dry chalky matte finish, no wet sheen, no gloss, no specular highlight. Shapes stay flat and graphic, never bulging off the skin.
Pigment applied directly on bare skin, pores and skin texture visible.
Motifs small and tightly repeated so each pattern reads as continuous texture at full-body scale. No panel, no band, no skirt or bodice shape.
The paint ends at the wrist and ankle in ONE thin crisp border no thicker than a fingerwidth; hands and feet bare. No second band anywhere.
All four hands fully visible, five separated fingers each, correct anatomy.
Nails long coffin-shaped, both lacquered matte burnt sienna.

Footwear: both wear matte ochre platform stiletto sandals, 3cm platform, open toe with painted toenails visible.
Environment: a deep near-black seamless studio void.
LIGHTING: a single hard key from the front right at 45 degrees, raking across BOTH bodies from the same side to carve the turned hip and the rotating torso. Weak rim from behind left. NOT symmetrical two-sided lighting.
Style: scientific fashion editorial. ultra-sharp 8K. portrait 2:3 vertical.
